correctness.rationale: All projections parameterize as UF with FU=I; the exact P* has five active rows of norm 845/659. Seven signed row forms give a global lower bound g(H). The positive barycentric identity and full rank identify the unit g-sublevel with a simplex having seven rational vertices. Exact row-norm computation at these vertices gives 493257/1508, hence the universal bound. A rational nonzero equality direction makes the constant sharp. Exact SymPy checker confirms all rational identities and determinants, while the analytic simplex and convexity argument establishes universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: The five-coordinate plane is a natural structural obstruction in a recent projection-constant/Banach–Mazur investigation. Uniqueness and the exact, globally attained strong-unicity modulus quantify the otherwise unknown robustness of the explicit optimal projector. The conditioning factor 493257/1508 is large and shows a meaningful sensitivity phenomenon. A complete seven-vertex first-order geometry, not a routine substitution or tiny numerical gain, supports the value.
